$comment: Enemies that wander in for the knight to fight. Clips come from the exported vanilla libraries in data/hk/animations (enemy art is always vanilla: skins/Vanilla; every enemy's art faces left and is mirrored to face right). `moves`: ground (walks / crawls along ledges, walks in from a monitor edge when its ledge reaches one, else drops in) or fly (flies in from the nearer side edge to hover `hover` units over a ledge). Clips: idle, move, turn (once, then mirrored), startle (once, on noticing the knight), chase (default: move), antic + attack + recover (a lunge that moves `lunge` units/s), fall (dropping in), death_air (struck dead, thrown back), death_land (lying dead; fades after a moment). `hp`: blows it takes (spells count more). `speed` / `chase_speed`: game units/s. `aggro`: notices the knight this close (game units; 0 = never, a harmless crawler that only bumps into him). `reach`: starts its attack this close. `size`: body [w, h] in game units (blows, contact, where the knight stands). `geo`: [min, max] burst when killed. `stay`: seconds it roams before wandering off if nobody fights it. `schedule`: like npcs.json `visits` (presence-time countdown; never during fullscreen apps, fast typing, or while a visitor is around). `rules`: `max_alive` at once, a visit brings `group` [min, max] of them, `stagger` seconds apart. The bored knight can also ask for one (world event).
